img: High-angle overhead medium shot looking down at a hospital bed in a stark single room under harsh white fluorescent light. Pale sheets, cold blue-grey tones.
vid: High-angle medium shot. The bandaged young man jerks upright in the hospital bed, gasping for air, chest heaving; the IV tube snaps taut and the IV stand rattles and sways. Audio: ragged heavy breathing, IV stand clattering, fast heart-monitor beeping. No music, no speech.

img: Full-bleed point-of-view shot from a hospital bed filling the entire frame edge to edge (no borders, no black bars): a stark single hospital room, venetian blinds letting thin bars of pale daylight across the floor, and on the wall a large plain round analog clock clearly showing the time 3:17 (hour hand just past 3, minute hand on 17 minutes). Slightly soft focus, washed-out cold tones.
vid: Handheld point-of-view shot, swaying slightly and drifting from blurry out-of-focus to sharp focus, slowly settling on the round wall clock reading 3:17; the second hand stays completely frozen, not moving. img: Close-up from above of a young man's two hands held palms-up over white hospital sheets. Dried black mud caked under the fingernails and in the creases between the fingers, a fresh red burn blister on the web between thumb and index finger, from gripping a rifle for hours. Hands trembling slightly. Bandaged wrist edge visible.
vid: Close-up of the two dirty hands slowly turning over, fingers trembling and flexing; he stares at the dried black mud under the nails and the fresh burn between thumb and forefinger. Slow subtle push-in. Audio: quiet room tone, soft fabric rustle, faint slow heart-monitor beep. No music, no speech.

img: Macro close-up, the steel military dog tag fills the center of the frame, hanging upright from a ball chain on the hook of a hospital IV stand, front face toward camera, perfectly readable. The top half of the tag's surface is destroyed by many deep scratch gouges where a name was scraped off. The bottom half shows a large, bold, deeply embossed upright number 07 in raised block digits, sharp and clearly legible. Background: blurred IV bag and fluorescent ceiling light, empty room.
vid: Close-up of the military dog tag hanging from the IV stand hook, gently swinging and slowly turning on its ball chain, light glinting off the scratched-out name and the number 07. Very slow push-in. Audio: faint metallic tinkle of the chain, hospital room tone. No music, no speech.

img: Medium shot inside the hospital room: the young man 07, bandaged chest, sitting in bed in the foreground on the left, frozen, head slowly turning toward the closed door on the right. The door has a frosted glass window; behind it two dark silhouettes of people stand in the corridor whispering. Cold, tense, dim.
vid: Medium shot. The young man in the bed holds his breath and slowly turns his head toward the door; two blurred silhouettes move behind the frosted door glass. Slow push-in toward the door handle. A man's low whispering voice outside the door says in Mandarin Chinese: "他醒了？……記住，他什麼都不能想起來。" Audio: hushed muffled voices, tense silence, faint heart-monitor beeps. No music.

img: Extreme macro close-up of the eye of the young man 07, dark grey iris, bloodshot, the pupil contracting, wet sheen, the black pupil dominating the center of the frame.
vid: Extreme macro close-up of the eye. The pupil contracts sharply, then the camera pushes rapidly straight into the black pupil until the frame is consumed by darkness. Audio: rising low whoosh and heartbeat thump, then silence. No music, no speech.

img: Extreme wide aerial shot at night in a violent rainstorm over a jagged border mountain range. A dark military helicopter with all lights off flies low, hugging a mountain ridge line. Heavy rain streaks, black-blue clouds, a faint flash of distant lightning outlining the ridges.
vid: Extreme wide aerial drone shot at night in a heavy rainstorm: a blacked-out military helicopter flies low along a jagged mountain ridge, camera tracking alongside; distant lightning flickers across the clouds. Audio: heavy rain, deep rotor thump, rolling thunder. No music, no speech.

img: Medium shot inside a dark military helicopter cabin at night lit by dim red cabin light. Six special forces soldiers in black-olive tactical gear and helmets, faces smeared with camouflage paint, sitting on benches. The squad leader, a hard-faced man in his forties with a scar, leans forward and taps his helmet while briefing. Rain streaks on the small window.
vid: Inside a dark helicopter cabin lit by dim red light, the scarred squad leader in his forties taps his helmet and says firmly in Mandarin Chinese: "人質八名，關在廢棄礦場。四十分鐘內進去、救人、撤出來。" The soldiers listen silently, the cabin shaking. Audio: rotor noise, rain on the fuselage, his voice. No music.

img: Close two-shot inside a dark helicopter cabin under dim red light. On the left, the young man 07, the youngest soldier, face smeared with camouflage paint, his gloved fingers trembling on his rifle. On the right a grinning soldier in his twenties with a buzz cut and camouflage paint, Ah-Jie, holding out a stick of chewing gum to him.
vid: Inside the shaking red-lit helicopter cabin, the young soldier's fingers tremble on his rifle. The grinning buzz-cut soldier beside him presses a stick of chewing gum into his hand and says with a cocky grin in Mandarin Chinese: "菜鳥，回去記得請我喝酒。" The young man takes it, a faint nervous smile. Audio: rotor noise, his voice. No music.

img: Night-vision green monochrome image: a squad of special forces soldiers in single file advancing through thick mud and heavy rain on a forest slope, rifles raised, helmets with night-vision goggles. Grainy green NVG look with bright speckle noise and rain streaks.

img: Night-vision green point-of-view looking at the entrance of an abandoned mine in a hillside at night in the rain: rusted rail tracks leading into a dark tunnel mouth, rotting timber supports, no guards, no lights, unnaturally still. In the foreground a soldier's gloved hand raised in a closed fist signal.
vid: Green night-vision view of the dark abandoned mine entrance, eerily still. A soldier in the foreground raises a clenched fist and holds it; the squad freezes. Audio: rain, then an ominous quiet. No music, no speech.

img: Extreme close-up of a military radio handset clipped to a rain-soaked tactical vest at night, a small green signal LED glowing, raindrops on the black plastic, a gloved hand gripping it.
vid: Extreme close-up of the radio on the wet tactical vest, its LED flickering. Through crackling radio static, an unfamiliar cold male voice says in Mandarin Chinese: "……他們到了。" Then the squad leader's voice nearby shouts in Mandarin: "撤——" Audio: radio static, rain. No music.

img: Extreme wide shot at night of a rain-soaked mountain cliff above an abandoned mine: a whole row of muzzle flashes erupting along the ridge, a parachute flare rising and lighting up the falling rain into countless glowing white lines, tiny silhouettes of soldiers below caught in the open.
vid: Slow motion extreme wide shot: muzzle flashes ripple along the cliff top, an illumination flare rises into the sky and turns the falling rain into thousands of glowing white streaks; soldiers below scatter in slow motion. Audio: slowed, muffled deep gunfire booms, rain. No music, no speech.

img: Point-of-view at night in rain, dim orange flare light: a young grinning buzz-cut soldier with camouflage face paint is falling backward toward the camera-holder, his mouth open as if saying something, mud and rain, blurred muzzle flashes in background.
vid: Slow-motion point-of-view shot: the buzz-cut soldier in front staggers and falls backward into the mud, his lips still moving silently as he looks at the camera. Everything silent except a single high-pitched tinnitus ringing tone. Muffled, dreamlike. No music, no dialogue audible.
